Synopsys Discovery Verification IP for MIPI DSI
Version O-2018.09

Introduction
This is O-2018.09 version of Synopsys Discovery Verification IP for MIPI DSI.

The Synopsys Discovery Verification IP for MIPI DSI is a suite of advanced verification components and data objects based on SystemVerilog UVM-compliant technology. This on-line help contains information about the classes, functions, and member variables. It shows class hierarchy and contents and it provides links you can use to navigate for more details.The following list provides the summary of the components and the user interface of the MIPI DSI VIP.

MIPI DSI VIP Components

  • svt_mipi_dsi_host_agent Defines an agent for the MIPI DSI Host component. The Host agent encapsulates Sequencers, DSI Host Driver, DPHY(Serial/PPI) or CPHY(Serial/PPI) drivers, and DSI Monitor ,DPHY(Serial/PPI) or CPHY(Serial/PPI) monitors. PHY layer selection (CPHY or DPHY) is done using a configuration attribute. The Host agent can be configured to operate in active mode and passive mode.

  • svt_mipi_dsi_device_agent Defines an agent for the MIPI DSI Device component. The Device agent encapsulates Sequencers, DSI Device Driver, DPHY(Serial/PPI) or CPHY(Serial/PPI) receivers, and DSI Monitor, DPHY(Serial/PPI) or CPHY(Serial/PPI) monitors. The Device agent can be configured to operate in active mode and passive mode.

  • svt_mipi_dsi_dual_host_agent defines DSI Dual Host agent for multiple DSI ports. DSI Dual Host agent contains Active and Passive components. Virtual Sequencer, DSI Sequencers & DSI Drivers are the active components while DSI Monitors are passive components. Active components can be disabled using configuration.

  • svt_mipi_dsi_dual_device_agent defines DSI Dual Device agent for multiple DSI ports. DSI Dual Device agent contains Active and Passive components. Virtual Sequencer, DSI Sequencers & DSI Drivers are the active components while DSI Monitors are passive components. Active components can be disabled using configuration.

MIPI DSI VIP User Interface
Configuration Objects:
The Configuration data objects convey the agent level, protocol and phy layer level configurations. These data objects contain built-in constraints, which come into effect when the configuration objects are randomized. If the configuration needs to be changed later, it can be done through reconfigure() method of the agent level components. The MIPI DSI VIP defines following configuration classes:

  • svt_mipi_dsi_dual_configuration - defines the MIPI DSI Dual component configuration fields
  • svt_mipi_dsi_dual_agent_configuration - defines the MIPI DSI Dual agent configuration fields and extends from svt_mipi_dsi_dual_configuration
  • svt_mipi_dsi_agent_configuration - defines the MIPI DSI agent configuration fields
  • svt_mipi_dsi_configuration - defines the MIPI DSI configuration fields configure the MIPI DSI Host or Device and setup the verification environment
  • svt_mipi_lane_configuration - defines the MIPI DSI Lane layer configuration
  • svt_mipi_cphy_configuration - CPHY configuration data and methods used to configure the protocol features of the CPHY components. This object contains rand configuration variables with 'valid' and 'reasonable' constraints.

Transaction Objects:
The transaction objects, which are extended from the uvm_transaction base class, define a unit of MIPI DSI protocol information that is passed across the bus. The attributes of transaction objects are public and are accessed directly for setting and getting values. Most transaction attributes can be randomized. The transaction object represents the desired activity to be simulated on the bus, or the actual bus activity that was monitored. MIPI DSI VIP defines the following transaction classes:

  • svt_mipi_dsi_packet - MIPI DSI packet transaction
  • svt_mipi_lane_transaction - MIPI DPHY lane transaction
  • svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction - MIPI CPHY lane transaction. It has properties which is used by CPHY layer.

Transactor Classes:

  • svt_mipi_dsi_host - MIPI DSI Host transactor which drives the TX transactions on interface.
  • svt_mipi_dsi_device - MIPI DSI Device transactor which samples the TX transactions from interface and drives RX transactions on interface.
  • svt_mipi_dsi_monitor - MIPI DSI Monitor which samples traffic coming from TX and RX directions.
  • svt_mipi_dsi_dual_monitor - MIPI DSI Dual Monitor. It defines DSI dual Monitor used to process the traffic from multiple DSI monitors in the TX and RX directions
  • svt_mipi_cphy_serial - MIPI CPHY Transactor.It defines the CPHY Serial Driver, used to process traffic in the forward and reverse directions.
  • svt_mipi_cphy_ppi - MIPI CPHY PPI Transactor.It defines the CPHY PPI Driver, used to process traffic in the TX and RX directions.

Callbacks:
The callbacks are an access mechanism that enable the insertion of user-defined code and allow access to objects for scoreboarding and functional coverage. Each Host, Device and Monitor components are associated with a callback class that contains a set of callback methods. MIPI DSI VIP provides the following callbacks classes:

  • svt_mipi_dsi_dual_monitor_callback - (MIPI Dual DSI Monitor callback class)
  • svt_mipi_dsi_device_callback - (MIPI DSI Device transactor callback class)
  • svt_mipi_dsi_host_callback - (MIPI DSI Host transactor callback class)
  • svt_mipi_dsi_monitor_callback - (MIPI DSI Monitor callback class)
  • svt_mipi_cphy_serial_callback - CPHY Serial callback class. It defines Serial component callback methods.
  • svt_mipi_cphy_serial_monitor_callback - CPHY Serial monitor callback class. It defines Serial monitor component callback methods.
  • svt_mipi_cphy_ppi_callback - CPHY PPI callback class. It defines PPI component callback methods.
  • svt_mipi_cphy_ppi_monitor_callback - CPHY PPI monitor callback class. It defines PPI monitor component callback methods.

Error Injection:
The error injection is a mechanism which contains built-in constraints to inject error code based on the user defined exception list. MIPI DSI VIP provides the following exception classes for error injection:

  • svt_mipi_dsi_packet_exception - defines the MIPI DSI Packet exception class to support packet level error injection
  • svt_mipi_lane_transaction_exception - defines the MIPI DSI Lane exception class to support lane level error injection
  • svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception - MIPI CPHY Lane exception class to support CPHY lane level error injection
  • svt_mipi_dsi_packet_exception_list - MIPI DSI Packet exception list class
  • svt_mipi_lane_transaction_exception_list - MIPI DPHY Lane exception list class
  • svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception_list - MIPI CPHY Lane exception list class

Protocol Checks:
MIPI DSI components incorporates built in protocol checks and generates messages for unexpected protocol behavior during the simulation. MIPI DSI VIP provides the following protocol checks:

  • svt_mipi_dsi_host_common_sc - MIPI DSI Host packet checks
  • svt_mipi_dsi_device_common_sc - MIPI DSI Device packet checks
  • svt_mipi_dsi_monitor_common_sc - MIPI DSI Monitor packet checks
  • svt_mipi_dphy_common_sc - MIPI DSI serial transmission checks
  • svt_mipi_ppi_common_sc - MIPI DSI parallel transmission checks
  • svt_mipi_cphy_serial_common_err_check - CPHY Serial common checks. It defines all Serial checks which are common to both Forward and Reverse directions.
  • svt_mipi_cphy_serial_forward_direction_err_check - CPHY Serial Forward Direction checks. It defines only Serial Forward direction checks.
  • svt_mipi_cphy_serial_reverse_direction_err_check - CPHY Serial Reverse Direction checks. It defines only Serial Reverse direction checks.
  • svt_mipi_cphy_ppi_err_check - CPHY PPI common checks. It defines PPI checks which are common to both TX and RX.
  • svt_mipi_cphy_ppi_tx_err_check - CPHY PPI TX checks. It defines only PPI TX checks.
  • svt_mipi_cphy_ppi_rx_err_check - CPHY PPI RX checks. It defines only PPI RX checks.

Dual DSI Protocol Checks:
MIPI Dual DSI components incorporates built in protocol checks and generates messages for unexpected protocol behavior during the simulation. MIPI Dual DSI VIP provides the following protocol checks:

  • svt_mipi_dsi_dual_err_check - MIPI Dual DSI protocol checks

Sequences:
MIPI DSI components incorporates built in response generation sequences for the sequence generation of Device component. MIPI DSI VIP provides the following sequences:

  • svt_mipi_dsi_device_default_response_sequence - MIPI DSI response sequence collection

Interfaces:
SystemVerilog models signal connections using interfaces. Interfaces define the set of signals which make up a port connection. Interfaces define a collection of signals for a given port, the direction of the signals, and the clock with respect to which these signals are driven and sampled. MIPI DSI VIP provides the following interfaces:

  • svt_mipi_dsi_host_if - MIPI DSI Host interface
  • svt_mipi_dsi_device_if - MIPI DSI Device interface
  • svt_mipi_cphy_if - CPHY Serial interface
  • svt_mipi_cphy_ppi_if - CPHY PPI interface
